nodes.label: Admin Web UI (FastAPI + Jinja2 + HTMX)
nodes.rationale: Primary way releases are worked from draft to live; local app with no build step, Python changes need restart, templates live-reload.

nodes.label: Background Job Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Long-running steps run as threads with state persisted in SQLite at ~/.mrp/admin.db keyed slug/step; HTMX fragment polls until done and releaseSaved/promoterSaved HX-Triggers refresh the UI live.

nodes.label: Slice-Save YAML IO
nodes.rationale: All YAML IO goes through load_structured_record/serialize_structured_record; each stage patches only the keys it owns so concurrent edits to other sections survive.

nodes.label: Artifact Keying (artist_id--track_slug)
nodes.rationale: Every downstream artifact (critic records, published reviews, preview snippets) is keyed by artist_id--track_slug, making artist_id changes expensive and gated.

nodes.label: Artist Change Migration Workflow
nodes.rationale: Because artifacts are keyed by artist_id, changing a release's artist_id on the Details stage triggers a confirmation workflow that renames/re-keys everything via artist_artifact_moves/migrate_artist_artifacts in mrp/admin/workspace.py.

nodes.label: Critic Pipeline (three passes)
nodes.rationale: Per-track review, album pass, contextual reviews; reviews land pending and writeback only writes approved/publishable; critic binaries invoked via absolute paths under app/critic/.venv/bin/ because they are not on PATH.

nodes.label: Sampler Stage
nodes.rationale: Plays the master in-browser, marks start/end, cuts a -14 LUFS preview snippet via ffmpeg into site/public/samples/.

nodes.label: Promoter Stage
nodes.rationale: Regenerates the artist's promo blurb and bios from recent releases + reviews; human review marks bio_auto_generated false.

nodes.label: Publish Pipeline (build > stage > verify > approve > publish)
Forward-Only Release Status Ladder
nodes.rationale: Status advances forward-only with publish steps via _advance_release_status in mrp/admin/pipeline.py: build > staged, verify > verified, approve > approved, publish > live; drafts are excluded from site builds.

hyperedges.label: Release Workspace Stage Flow (intake to publish)
